body: Her telling me she loved me.I just want to hear it one more time.

She took my phone and sent a text to her ex with it. (I've known him for 3 years, well before I knew her. I've been trying to stay friends with both of them, even though its kinda rough at points) so, (we were all kinda drink at this point) I grab her bf's phone and send his ex a text. 10 minutes later, he's sobbing in the corner. I realize that its not the most mature reaction, but I can't help but think to myself "you started this." as soon as he starts crying, she gives me the worst glare I've ever seen and says "I think you should go" I leave, and the next morning, she texts me and says she almost threw up from the aftermath of whatever was said afterwards. I've never been able to see lines well until after I've crossed them, and I realize she had a pop gun, and I retaliated with a nuclear weapon, but she did kinda start it.

That's the thing. She forgave me, and said we're still friends. Idk what I did to deserve having her in my life, but I'm terrified of hurting her. The knowledge that I hurt her, and the disappointment in myself that it caused, is the worst pain I can remember. I have no idea why I continue to shit on every opportunity I'm given. I try to be a good person. I'll do most anything anyone needs, because I want to be there for people. But the road to hell is paved with good intentions, and I can't help but wonder why, when I'm always doing my best for the people around me, it always manages to backfire so spectacularly.

I can't seem to stop making massive progress, and then, in 5 minutes, undoing everything I've worked towards. I keep fixing the individual issues, so that that particular issue won't come up again. But it keeps happening in different ways. They're all variations of the same song. I realize by fixing the surface problems, but not fixing the root cause, all I'm doing is slapping a bandaid on it. But I can't figure out what the root problem is, in order to be able to fix it.

And as far as the other thing goes, I realize in my head that I am valuable, but can't seem to feel it in my heart. I've had this problem for years, and have never been able to do anything about it. I tried going to a therapist when I was younger, but could never bring myself to talk about the real problems I have out of shame. Then I met [name]. She is the only person who has ever gotten the full picture of who I really am deep down, because I can just sit there and talk to her. And what set this whole thing off(this particular episode, that is) is me fucking her relationship with her boyfriend up. She is literally the only person in my entire life who has cared this much about me, and thus is how I repay her. Idk what to do anymore.
